<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Supreme Court intervention:</strong> The Supreme Court stayed a Madras High Court order that had quashed a government policy providing jobs to the kin of Karur stampede victims, questioning the judiciary&#x27;s authority to interfere in executive policy decisions.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTFAzVXBVX2N2QmdmNGYzOUdqMTF6MVEySG5DWkJuMk1NaXMwSEZINmtPMDNPQUQzSGlWdUVYcnFKQTBMMUVqTmluOTZfX3JRakFfWHVLdFVrX19nREphTHpLVUZDYWlpek9sNHFfVGlreUgta3dYM1dZQTVFMnBFWlk?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Lok Sabha reforms:</strong> Parliament passed the MMDR Amendment Bill 2026 to overhaul mining rules and a separate bill increasing the Supreme Court&#x27;s judge strength to 38.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxOMDJPUkhhSzlYQ2pzVExDZUVjUHdZbWFiXzBaTnJlRHZxanZMdWJMZVd5Q0pTVlF3eUV1eGRtVDd4S2s4UHJCR09McGZfS0wwei1vcGNLTHdYMloyX21heFh5Ym4tZk5USXB2TXJHTTFvTGhXS0o5SlBGUkNaQ2lqUllmdDV0WGxwc2NBaWh6dFJuejhnekNWMHZRajRoNTd4ZVZGQUZEUQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I24</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Delimitation concerns:</strong> Tamil Nadu CM Vijay wrote to PM Modi urging the government to freeze Lok Sabha strength at 543 seats while ensuring a 33% reservation for women.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I18</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>
